# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sqlite3, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
db = r'D:\github\miniBot\data\memory.db'
con = sqlite3.connect(db)
cur = con.cursor()
print('=== facts_v2 中 scope=main 的全部条目 ===')
cur.execute("SELECT key, value FROM facts_v2 WHERE scope='main'")
for k, v in cur.fetchall():
    print('KEY:', k)
    print('VAL:', v)
    print('---')
print('\n=== facts_v2 中所有 scope 的 key 一览 ===')
cur.execute("SELECT scope, key FROM facts_v2")
for s, k in cur.fetchall():
    print(s, '|', k)
print('\n=== 搜索含 鹈鹕/pelican/自行车/bike 的记忆(跨所有表) ===')
cur.execute("SELECT scope, key, substr(value,1,80) FROM facts_v2 WHERE value LIKE '%鹈鹕%' OR value LIKE '%pelican%' OR value LIKE '%自行车%' OR value LIKE '%bike%'")
rows = cur.fetchall()
print('facts_v2 命中:', len(rows))
for r in rows:
    print(r)
con.close()
